notes.title: Infinite Mode Update
notes.content:
Hello, players.

I just updated the game below.:

1. Infinite Mode add.
 - Infinite Mode are no score and play the game in infinite time.
 - Infinite Mode are also save and explore.

2. Update Building Level Text Visibility.
 - The level text of the building that is close to the same level as the tiles to be placed is highlighted in green.

again, thanks for playing.

best regards.
